title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East  (Late Show) on 1970-05-15
source: source: aud cassette master; taped by Jimmy Cooper; 2 hitachi mics > hitachi trq-222; nakamichi dragon > benchmark adc1 24/96 > mac > adobe audition cc > fission > 16/44.1 xACT flac; power by furman p-2400IT; transfer & mastering - Rob Berger

ai_review.summary: Atmospheric audience recording with vivid crowd moments and strong Jerry vocals, though Dark Star is cut short
ai_review.review: The reviewer loves the show’s emotional peaks – laughing and crying during St. Stephen and the jovial feel of Uncle John’s Band captured by the audible crowd. Jerry’s backing vocals and his rare pedal‑steel work are highlighted, while a recording glitch cuts off the Dark Star, leaving that moment unfinished.

ai_rating.rationale: Single enthusiastic 5‑star review praises performance and atmosphere; minor recording loss prevents a perfect score

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crowd is clearly audible, adding atmosphere; however the Dark Star segment clips out, indicating a brief dropout.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Emotional early set with St. Stephen drawing strong audience reaction, followed by a lively Uncle John’s Band; overall pacing feels engaging despite the missing Dark Star portion.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Backing vocals praised; rare pedal‑steel playing noted as a highlight
